CustomField.label: Sync Direction
CustomField.description: How the integration syncs. Values: bidirectional | sf_to_veleiro | veleiro_to_sf. Blank defaults to bidirectional. Set it from the Veleiro Mappings panel.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: bidirectional, sf_to_veleiro, or veleiro_to_sf. Controls whether Salesforce pushes, pulls, or both. Best set from the Veleiro Mappings panel.
